name: architect-os-studio
description: Turn website mockups into importable Elementor websites.
author: Map Ranking

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.prep: npm run prep:engine && npm run prep:python && npm run prep:icon
scripts.build:msi: npm run prep && npm run build && electron-builder --win msi
scripts.build:win: npm run prep && npm run build && electron-builder --win msi nsis
scripts.build:mac: npm run prep:engine && npm run prep:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.build:all: npm run prep && npm run build && electron-builder -mw
scripts.release: npm run prep && npm run build && electron-builder --win msi --publish always
